targets.notes: Mobile operator with clear pricing tiers. Limited hours (closed Mon-Wed). Gmail-based email suggests small/individual operation. Prime candidate for automated booking system - mobile detailers can't answer phones while working.

outreach_strategy.priority_1_approach: Call Jonathan at (440) 428-8012 during business hours (Mon-Fri 9AM-7PM, Sat 9AM-2PM). Mention Uurable familiarity as conversation starter. Focus on integrated local platform benefits vs generic booking tool. Emphasize customer ownership and local SEO benefits.
outreach_strategy.priority_2_approach: Email lakesluxurywash@gmail.com - mobile operator with clear pain point (can't answer calls while detailing). Highlight mobile-specific features: SMS confirmations, location-based scheduling, automated reminders.

researcher_notes: Flawless Coating is interesting because they already use Uurable for booking - they're technically savvy but using a generic platform. Positioning should emphasize local ownership, customer data control, and Ashtabula-specific integration. Lake's Luxury Wash is a classic mobile operator pain point - they have clear published pricing but limited availability (closed 3 days/week). An automated booking system would let them capture leads even when they're working or closed.
